skills.name: Composite - Apply and spread mixture to a surface
skills.description: Use a tool to apply and spread mixture on a surface.

steps.activity: Take a scoop of mixture on the tool
Determine the position on the surface where the mixture will be applied
Position the tool at the application location on the surface
Swing the tool to apply the mixture to the surface
steps.category: Swing arm while holding an object

steps.activity: Rub the tool on the surface to spread the mixture

examples: Apply and spread mortar on a wall with a trowel
Pack mortar into a brick joint with a flat pointing iron

skills.name: Composite - Apply a liquid to a surface with a brush or roller
skills.description: Use a brush or roller to apply a liquid to a surface.

steps.activity: Determine the position on the surface where the liquid_to_apply will be applied
Position the application_tool near the location on the surface
Stroke the application_tool to apply the liquid_to_apply to the surface

examples: Apply paint to a wall with a brush

skills.name: Composite - Apply caulk or sealant from a gun or tube
skills.description: Apply caulk or sealant from a gun or tube to a surface or joint.

steps.activity: Position the application_tool on the surface
Press the plunger of the application_tool to dispense the paste_to_apply
Move the application_tool along the surface to apply the paste_to_apply
steps.category: Move tool along a linear path

examples: Apply caulk to a joint between two surfaces with a caulking gun
Apply sealant to a surface with a tube of sealant
